findings.issue: `flat_relativeBaseChange`'s docstring says "The relative flatness half of the effective Cartier condition". `IsEffectiveCartier` has no flatness half (line 48–50 of Basic.lean is purely about regular local equations); flatness is the second conjunct of `IsRelativeEffectiveCartier`. findings.evidence: Lines 25–32 list `IsRelativeEffectiveCartier`, `relativeBaseChangeSubschemeIso`, `flat_relativeBaseChange`, `relativeBaseChange_of_flat`; `relativeBaseChange_iff` is declared at line 93 and absent from the list.

findings.issue: The "Main results" list omits `IsRelativeEffectiveCartier.relativeBaseChange_iff`, which the PR itself presents as one of the five exported items ("its reduction theorem") and which is the statement a reader needs in order to use the partial arbitrary-base-change result.

summary: Every declaration is documented and the iso/flatness statements are described accurately, but the module docstring and one theorem docstring carry roadmap/future-work narrative about the unfinished arbitrary-base-change case, and one docstring misdescribes which condition has a "flatness half".
